title: Hale's Key
summary: On Day eight, Sam and Leo reach Mr. Hale and the key to the roof.

beats.text: Day eight. Biscuit yawned, a huge yawn, and not one sound came out.
The shapes lost interest and shuffled away. Leo grinned. "Good boy," he mouthed.
We slipped through the fourth floor door, and a hand pulled us inside.
Mr. Hale was tired and grey, with a ring of keys on his belt.
"Roof key," he said, and pressed it into my palm. "We climb tonight."
beats.speaker: hale

beats.text: The roof door was on twelve. Three floors above my flat, and the stairs were full.
At dusk, the rain began. Rain hides sound. It was our best chance.
Then the walkie hissed. Mrs. Okafor, whispering from 7B.
"Sam. Someone just knocked on my door. Three slow knocks."
beats.speaker: okafor

beats.text: The infected bang. They do not knock three times and wait.
